survey: A spiral or tiered topiary shrub in a round stone planter ring set into a terracotta-paved path, with lawn and a hedge behind. Main parts: (1) a low ring of cut-stone curb blocks, round and evenly segmented, sitting flat on the paving; (2) brown soil filling the ring; (3) the shrub, four stacked foliage tiers that get smaller toward the top, each shifted slightly to the side so they form a twisting spiral, ending in a small pointed tip. The widest bottom tier sits right on the soil inside the ring, and each upper tier rests on the one below with no gaps. No trunk shows, which is normal for densely clipped topiary. The planter faces the camera in three-quarter view from slightly above.
